yaml_metadata.name: ns_multi-zebrafish-gene_anatomy-expression_count_mapping-spatial_density
yaml_metadata.description: Map eomesa- and pvalb7-positive cells into a common zebrafish atlas from registered EASI-FISH volumes and cell-wise spot counts. Use for whole-brain expression density and co-expression maps.
triggers: Analyze whole-brain spatial mapping of molecularly defined neuronal populations
Use this recipe to register EASI-FISH brains, assign RNA spots to cells, call eomesa- and pvalb7-positive populations consistently, and map their spatial densities
